definitions.name: Strict Typist
definitions.description: mypy --strict (or pyright strict) is clean from P2 on.
definitions.criteria: `mypy --strict` (or `pyright` with strict mode) exits 0 on every python project p[2-9]-*

definitions.name: Match Maker
definitions.description: match statement with >=3 class patterns in domain code.
definitions.criteria: grep finds a `match` statement in python domain code with >=3 `case ClassName(` arms

definitions.name: Protocol Purist
definitions.description: All P3 driven ports are typing.Protocol and import-linter is green.
definitions.criteria: every driven port in the python P3 project is a class deriving from typing.Protocol AND `verify: arch p3` exits 0

definitions.name: Async All the Way
definitions.description: Async endpoint through async repository, Testcontainers test green.
definitions.criteria: P4/P5 python code has an async endpoint calling an async repository (no sync bridging) AND its Testcontainers-based test passes
